title: 第4章心死如灰第5章安全了么
slug: 我的民俗游戏机第227章权限
content_zh:
许峰跟在师父身后。
西房门口，两个大红灯笼高高挂着。相比于社庙之中其余地方，这一扇门时常关闭。
一根蒲草衔在了门边的石刻上。
许峰看了这石刻一眼，只是感觉此物狰狞异常，其余也没看出来甚么端倪蹊跷来。
也不用进门，许峰就嗅到了屋子之中传出来的血腥味道。
在这血腥味道之中，还有另外一层叫人作呕和恐惧的味道。
整个屋舍就泡在了如是的味道之中。这些味道尽管经过了清水和草药的清洗，但还是深深的渗入了这里的一砖一瓦之中，难以驱散。
看着许峰站在门口，高瘦师父凝视着许峰的后背，说道：“门没锁，打开罢！”
许峰推开了房门。
师父仔细看许峰的手，看到他手不抖，暗自点了点头。许峰打开之后，看了一眼师父，师父示意他进去。
手头没有火源，许峰硬着头皮走了进去。
刚一进去，许峰就察觉到了这屋子之中“奇异”之处。
这屋子里头比外面还要森寒三分，但却又不能呵气成雾。高瘦师父拿出来了火折子，吹亮，点燃了西房里头的好几处蜡烛，叫这里亮堂起来。
在这光亮之中，许峰也看清楚了这西房的摆设。
几乎可以称之为空空荡荡。
除了屏风，许峰没有看到其余家具。
墙上也不见装饰。
“和我来罢。”
师父说罢，绕开了屏风，来到了屏风后面。
许峰跟着过去，看到了屏风后面的几个大床！或者说是大桌子！

拼凑在一起，许峰都不用认真思考，就知道这里是甚么地方。
停尸房。
这些草席盖住的，应该就是今天的“客户”！
不过看这个数量，今天的任务量有些大啊！
师父左右数了一下，确定尸体数量不多不少之后，说道：“选罢！看你今天选哪一个作为你开张的卖主！”
许峰又硬头皮，他现在就靠着一口想要保存之后，离开这里的气顶着。
要是气不泄，他就这样直接莽过去了，要是气泄了，那就完全没法子了。
就近掀开了一个草席，许峰看到了里头的“尸体”。
果是身首分离。
头颅就在一边，还在缓缓渗出液体！
不等许峰仔细端详这一具尸体，他师父就走了过来。随意看了一眼许峰的选择，说道：“你选的不错，这人死的时候没遭罪。
看这刀口，应该是你刘叔的手笔。
你刘叔是个慈善人，只要不是有人给他打了招呼，无论好坏，他都是一刀毙命，这人死的痛快，送来的也及时，应该也没什么戾气。可以直接缝了。”
许峰站在自己师父身边，和师父一起端详尸体，师父手持火烛，又将一盏火烛递给了许峰，说道：“咱们缝尸人，缝尸之前，一定要学会望闻问切。
这世道，人一旦死了，很难说会变成甚么。
content_en:
Xu Feng followed behind his master.
At the door of the west room, two red lanterns hang high. Compared with the rest of the temple, this door is often closed.
A bulrush was stuck on the stone carving beside the door.
Xu Feng glanced at the stone carving and felt that it was something ferocious and unusual, but he didn't see any other clues about it.
Xu Feng could smell the smell of blood coming from the room without even entering the door.
Among the smell of blood, there is another layer of nausea and fear.
The whole house was soaked in such a smell. Although these smells have been cleaned with water and herbs, they still seep deeply into every brick and tile here and are difficult to dispel.
Seeing Xu Feng standing at the door, the tall and thin master stared at Xu Feng's back and said: "The door is unlocked, just open it!"
Xu Feng pushed open the door.
Master looked at Xu Feng's hands carefully and nodded secretly when he saw that his hands were not shaking. After Xu Feng opened it, he glanced at his master, who motioned for him to enter.
With no fire source at hand, Xu Feng bit the bullet and walked in.
As soon as he entered, Xu Feng noticed something "strange" in this room.
It's even colder inside this room than outside, but it can't turn into fog. The tall and thin master took out the fire stick, blew it, and lit several candles in the west room, making the place brighter.
In this light, Xu Feng could also clearly see the furnishings of the west room.
You could almost call it empty.
Except for the screen, Xu Feng saw no other furniture.
There was no decoration on the walls either.
"Come with me."
After saying this, the master walked around the screen and came behind the screen.
Xu Feng followed and saw several large beds behind the screen! Or a big table!
Putting it all together, Xu Feng knew where this place was without thinking carefully.
Morgue.
Those covered by these straw mats should be today’s “customers”!
But looking at this amount, today’s task volume is a bit heavy!
The master counted left and right, and after confirming that the number of corpses was not too much or too little, he said: "Choose! Let's see which one you choose as your opening vendor today!"
Xu Feng was hard-headed again. He was just trying to hold on to the energy of leaving here after taking one bite.
If he wasn't angry, he would just pass it by. If he was angry, there would be nothing he could do.
A straw mat was opened nearby, and Xu Feng saw the "corpse" inside.
The result is separation of body and head.
The head is on the side, still slowly oozing liquid!
Before Xu Feng could take a closer look at the body, his master came over. He casually glanced at Xu Feng's choice and said, "You made a good choice. This man died without suffering.
Judging from the blade, it should be your Uncle Liu's handiwork.
Your Uncle Liu is a philanthropic person. As long as someone doesn't say hello to him, no matter good or bad, he will kill him with one knife. This man died happily and was delivered in time, so he should not be angry at all. You can sew directly. "
Xu Feng stood next to his master and looked at the corpse with his master. The master held a candle and handed another candle to Xu Feng and said: "We who sew corpses must learn to see, hear and inquire before we sew a corpse.
In this world, once a person dies, it is hard to say what will happen to him.
